SPEAKER: SPK_DOCTOR
TEXT: [FI] Although I can only perform a simple medical examination here, this is just a simple case of overwork and lack of sleep.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Whew... That's good to hear...

SPEAKER: SPK_DOCTOR
TEXT: [FI] Well then, I will be leaving for a while, let me know when she comes around, all right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's what the doctor said, Kuroneko.
[FI] It looks like Kuroneko... isn't going to be waking up anytime soon.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Wake up soon, I have to scold you no matter what.

[FI] We haven't been this close because of the distance between us.
[FI] Her cheeks are a little red... But, it seems that she has calmed down... That's really great...
[FI] She's been sulking a lot recently...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Haha... It'll be great if her mood gets better when she wakes up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Nnn...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Kuroneko, are you awake?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] This place is...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] The infirmary. Don't you remember? You collapsed all of a sudden.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...I do remember, quite clearly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Geez... But, since you're unexpectedly full of vigor, I'm quite relieved.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Besides, it's just lack of sleep and overwork, isn't it? You don't have to be so worried.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Even if it's nothing big, if you collapse, won't it be all for nothing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Right... Initially I thought I would be able to continue like this... I'm really worthless.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You...! Good grief, I can't handle you... You won't listen even if I say it again, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Of course. I'm not obliged to listen to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah yeah... Well, I'll just say it again just for the sake of it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] In short, stop overworking yourself... I can't always come out to stop you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...As for what happened this time, I feel that it's you who got me angry for no reason in the first place...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yes yes... It's my bad... Just take it as my fault then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But you know, you should take extra care since you already collapsed once. It will be troublesome if you aren't lucky.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's okay to make me worried. After all, it's me who's concerned for you on my own accord.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] However, if you're causing the others to worry... you should stop.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's better to avoid making everyone... sad.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...That's right... That's something I don't wish to see either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, is that so. It makes me happy that you're willing to listen.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well then... I'll go get the doctor here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ......Hold it.
